subject: Vendr evidence minimization & playback request
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine@astralogix.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: vendr-uploads@vendr.io
Date: Thu, 9 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendr evidence minimization & playback request

Hi Jonas / Marissa,

Thanks again for walking us through the Vendr portal last week. We have a tight compliance window for a Q1 audit and need to provide a smaller, focused bundle of artifacts to our procurement team and to Vendr so they can validate a SIG/CAIQ subset without ingesting our entire evidence bucket.

Request: can Redwood produce a "playback" bundle that contains:
- the minimal set of CAIQ controls (authz / encryption / logging) we flagged in the attached inventory
- a presigned upload window for a targeted manifest (we'll upload the subset to Vendr)
- a KMS-backed attestation (hash + signature) for the manifest so Vendr can prove possession and integrity

Attached: initial-evidence-inventory.csv (column: control, file_path, recommended_minimal_flag)

Timing: ideally a canary upload window and signed manifest by EOD Friday so our procurement can confirm scope. Is that feasible? If you need us to cut the list smaller, tell us which CAIQ controls you recommend we keep.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-min call if helpful.

— Elaine Park
Head of Security Programs, AstraLogix
elaine@astralogix.com

Attachment: initial-evidence-inventory.csv (csv)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@astralogix.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, vendr-uploads@vendr.io
Date: Thu, 9 Dec 2027 10:01:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendr evidence minimization & playback request

Hi Elaine — thanks for the clear ask and the inventory.

High level: yes, we can produce a minimized playback bundle and provide a presign window + KMS-signed manifest. Plan:
1) I will run a quick reconciliation against your CSV and our evidence index to mark the minimal files.
2) Mina will prepare a short KMS attestation (hash list + time-stamped signature).
3) We will create a presigned S3 window and upload manifest for Vendr, and send the signed manifest back to you.

Couple quick clarifying questions so we scope the canary correctly:
- Which CAIQ sections are absolute must-include? You mentioned authz/encryption/logging — confirm if we should keep network controls too.
- Do you want the presign window limited to a single object (manifest) or a small file set?

If you want, we can open the canary presign to vendr-uploads only and include a one-hour TTL. I can turn around a proof-of-possession PDF (kms-attestation.pdf) once Mina confirms key metadata.

I'll aim to get the presign and signed manifest to you by 15:30 PT today if we have the final minimal list.

— Jonas
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
Attachment: presign-instructions.txt (text)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Dec 2027 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: AstraLogix — quick mapping + KMS workflow

Mina / Marissa — moving this to you for the heavy lift. Summary: Astra wants a minimal playback bundle and a KMS-signed manifest for Vendr ingestion. Action items:
- Marissa: run the CSV they attached against our evidence index and flag the minimal set (authz/encryption/logging controls + any network controls we decide). Keep the list under ~12 artifacts for the canary.
- Mina: prepare a KMS attestation with the following fields: key id, timestamp, SHA-256 hashes for each artifact, and a signature blob we can hand to vendr. PDF + detached signature preferred.
- I'll provision a one-hour S3 presign restricted to vendr-uploads@vendr.io and provide the URL & manifest schema.

Constraints / notes:
- We should avoid handing over raw SOC2 report pages unless they are already redacted. Keep PII out.
- If Mina needs help extracting key metadata from our HSM logs, I can loop infra.

Please reply in-thread with ETA — Elaine is hoping for EOD Friday.

Thanks,
Jonas

[internal: do not CC external until we have the signed manifest]

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Dec 2027 13:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Internal: AstraLogix — quick mapping + KMS workflow

Thanks — I can take the attestation. Quick notes:
- I will pull the HSM key metadata and output a signed PDF (kms-attestation.pdf) + a detached signature file (signed-manifest.json.sig).
- For speed, I'll include a short hash manifest (presign-manifest.json) containing SHA-256 entries and the KMS key id.
- ETA for initial artifacts: 15:00 PT. That gives Jonas time to create the presign URL and for us to validate the signature.

I also uploaded a helper folder with the attestation template and manifest schema: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_evidence-playback

Mina
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com
Attachment: kms-attestation.pdf (pdf)

From: Elaine Park <elaine@astralogix.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, vendr-uploads@vendr.io
Date: Thu, 9 Dec 2027 15:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendr evidence minimization & playback request

Thanks — this looks good. Two quick confirms:
1) We only need the CAIQ sections you called out (authz, encryption, logging). Network controls can be omitted for the canary.
2) One-hour presign to vendr-uploads is perfect. Please use the manifest schema Mina uploaded.

If you can send the presign link + signed-manifest.json.sig when ready, we will do a single small test upload and confirm ingestion. After that, procurement will sign off and we'll schedule a broader sync.

Appreciate the responsiveness.

— Elaine
Head of Security Programs, AstraLogix

Quoted earlier: "I'll aim to get the presign and signed manifest to you by 15:30 PT today if we have the final minimal list."

Attachment: signed-manifest.json.sig (sig)
